boot.command: <command that starts the app in the foreground with its local profile>

database.up: <command that creates, migrates, and seeds the disposable local database>
database.reset: <command that returns that database to its seeded state>
database.datasource: <command that prints the datasource the active profile resolves>

egress.hostsCommand: <command that prints every outbound host the active profile resolves, one per line>

appLog: <file the app logs to, relative to the worktree root>

routes.path: <local OpenAPI document, relative to the worktree root>

auth.headerCommand: <command that prints one Name: value header for a seeded local user>

errorContract: <file and section where the repository documents its 4xx error shape>
